page_title: BET 2-1 CEL | Betis v Celta Vigo 12/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+7' Pablo Fornals (Betis) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+6' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

90+5' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
90+4' The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.

90+1' 2 - 1 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) deflects his teammate's shot, which was heading in the opposite direction, using his body. The goalkeeper reacted to the earlier shot and the deflection confused him. No chance of stopping that.

90+1' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Rui Silva anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
90' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

88' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
86' Substitution. Rodri (Betis) has come on for Isco.
84' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Juan Martinez Munuera to decide. The relieved Betis players can finally celebrate.
84' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Betis players aren’t happy.
83' 2 - 0 Goal! Nabil Fekir (Betis) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the top left corner.
81' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Hugo Alvarez and he is replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) replaces Carlos Dominguez.
81' Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
80' Nabil Fekir (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
79' Nabil Fekir (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
76' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
75' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abner (Betis) replacing Juan Miranda.
74' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
70' Jonathan Bamba goes off the pitch and Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) comes on.
70' Here's the change. Hugo Sotelo leaves the pitch and Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
70' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) replaces Hector Bellerin.
67' Rui Silva (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
66' The game is interrupted now, Rui Silva (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Substitution. Javier Manquillo walks off the pitch and Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
63' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
62' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' The resulting corner from Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
59' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.

58' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
56' Hector Bellerin (Betis) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

53' 1 - 0 Goal! Hector Bellerin displays great vision and sends a pass to Juan Miranda (Betis), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
53' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Nabil Fekir (Betis) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
50' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Isco (Betis) takes it short.
50' Isco (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
49' Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
47' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez Munuera signals a set piece.
46' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Ayoze Perez will be replaced by Nabil Fekir (Betis).
46' Half-time substitution. Willian Jose (Betis) will not participate anymore and Cedric Bakambu is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Ayoze Perez (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+2' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to German Pezzella (Betis) for a tough tackle.
45+1' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo win a corner kick.
41' Juan Miranda (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
38' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
35' Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo).
32' Willian Jose (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared.
32' Ayoze Perez (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.

29' German Pezzella (Betis) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
29' Pablo Fornals (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
27' Willian Jose (Betis) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
26' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

25' Oscar Mingueza clips a neat ball into the box towards Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
24' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
23' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
22' The game is interrupted as Willian Jose (Betis) is flagged offside.
21' Juan Miranda (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
20' Hector Bellerin (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
19' Juan Miranda (Betis) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
17' Isco (Betis) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
16' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Celta Vigo earn a corner.

14' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Rui Silva anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
13' The free kick is delivered by Juan Miranda (Betis) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

12' Jailson (Celta Vigo) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Betis have a corner.
10' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.

6' Juan Miranda plays a delightful lofted ball into the middle of the box and it deserved better, but Isco (Betis) could only send a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
5' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
